In this experiment, you are to investigate the period of oscillation of a rule attached to a spring.
Record all of your observations on page 5 of your Answer Booklet.
Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 3.1.

The rule has one end lightly taped to the bench so that it does not slip. The other end is attached
to a spring. Do not change the position of the spring.

parts.label: a
parts.text:
Place the load L on the rule so that its centre is over the 80.0 cm mark. Record the distance
d from the centre of the load to the end A of the rule.

content.html: Place the load L on the rule so that its centre is over the 80.0 cm mark. Record the distance d from the centre of the load to the end A of the rule.
content.text: Place the load L on the rule so that its centre is over the 80.0 cm mark. Record the distance d from the centre of the load to the end A of the rule.

parts.label: b
parts.text:
Displace the end B of the rule a small distance downwards and release it so that it oscillates.
Record the time t taken for 10 complete oscillations of the rule.

parts.label: c
parts.text: Calculate the period T of the oscillations. T is the time for one complete oscillation.
